text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةًۭ فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a new explanatory unit after the prior decree
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) The opening connector resumes the discourse after the prior destruction decree (17:58) and starts the ayah as an explanation, while also beginning the three-part cadence of restraint, exemplum, and present rule.

topics.headline: resumption after the prior decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts as an explanation of the destruction horizon stated just before it (17:58), not as an isolated new topic.
topics.reason: The connector opens a resumed discourse unit after 17:58 according to the boundary and discourse rows.

topics.headline: three-part conjunction frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move in three beats: past restraint, the named exemplum, and present policy.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction rows identify three major clause openings in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: opening negator in a restriction frame that excludes every cause except prior denial
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) This negator does not imply inability; it begins an exclusive explanation of why signs are withheld and prepares the matching final restriction that brackets the Thamud exemplum in a cause-purpose ring.

topics.headline: opening restriction excludes rival causes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the restraint is framed as policy with one named cause, not as divine inability or scarcity.
topics.reason: The negation is completed by the exception particle and restricts possible causes to prior denial.

topics.headline: first half of a doubled restriction frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first restriction will be answered by the final restriction, giving the ayah a ring around the exemplum.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows explicitly tie the opening negation to the later matching restriction and central exemplum.

words.gloss_range: completed act of restraint governing the act of sending; the withholding can also feel protective without leaving the local prevention sense
words.root_gloss_range: root range of barring, withholding, forbidding, and protecting; here the local verb selects restraint while defense/protection remains as pressure
words.prose: {{ar:مَنَعَنَآ}} ({{tr:mana'ana}}) The verb makes sign-withholding a settled divine action, with the prevented act packaged in the following clause. The root pressure allows restraint to feel like shielding from a destructive sign-test pattern, while the local Form I frame keeps simple transitive prevention as the selected sense. Variant rows make the restraint feel heavier without replacing the canonical form, and the blocked-action formula contrasts divine withholding here with people blocking belief (17:94) and another restriction pattern (18:55) as the prior decree horizon (17:58) becomes first-person policy speech.

topics.headline: perfect restraint governs the blocked sending act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the withholding of signs as a completed divine response whose object is the act of sending.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify a perfect transitive verb governing the following content clause.

topics.headline: withholding also carries protective pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses restraint as possible shielding from a destructive sign-test pattern, while the local verb still means prevention.
topics.reason: Root rows press both deprivation and defense, but local grammar selects restraint in this clause.

topics.headline: variant thickens prevention without replacing the main form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variant pressure can make restraint feel heavier while the canonical surface remains simple Form I.
topics.reason: Variant rows describe intensified Form II pressure; QAC alignment keeps the local surface as Form I.

topics.headline: prevention formula answers earlier decree pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the restraint verb with recurring blocked-action formulas and the prior decree horizon (17:58; 17:94; 18:55).
topics.reason: Intertext and boundary rows connect the construction to comparable blocked-action frames and the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle that nominalizes the following sending clause as the thing withheld
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) The particle turns the following sending verb into the grammatical object of restraint. It also balances with the later particle before the denial clause, so the blocked act and the cause of blocking face each other as parallel clauses.

topics.headline: sending clause becomes the object withheld
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah withholds the act of sending signs itself, packaged as a grammatical object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following clause the governed content complement of the restraint verb.

topics.headline: blocked act and cause are balanced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prevented act and the cause of prevention placed in matching clause slots.
topics.reason: Rows connect the first particle before the sending clause with the second before the denial clause.

words.gloss_range: dependent Form IV sending verb: a withheld dispatch held in subjunctive suspension
words.root_gloss_range: root range of sending, releasing, dispatching, and commissioning; here Form IV selects deliberate divine dispatch
words.prose: {{ar:نُّرْسِلَ}} ({{tr:nursila}}) The sending verb is governed and subjunctive, so the dispatch of signs is held as a prevented action rather than narrated as an event. Its root keeps the image of controlled release, and its later recurrence in indicative mood turns the suspended dispatch into a standing policy. The same sending-restriction pattern appears in purpose-limit formulas (6:48; 18:56), while the contrast with blocked human belief (17:94) keeps the agency shift visible.

topics.headline: subjunctive sending is held in suspension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first sending is grammatically dependent and withheld, not yet the standing policy stated later.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the preceding particle and marked as subjunctive in QAC-compatible data.

topics.headline: root and Form IV make sending deliberate dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees signs as deliberately released or commissioned, not as passive appearances.
topics.reason: Root and form rows support controlled release and Form IV causative dispatch.

topics.headline: withheld dispatch returns as final policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same sending root from prevented action to present-purpose rule.
topics.reason: Echo rows identify the later recurrence with changed mood and clause role.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the signs as the medium or accompaniment of the withheld dispatch
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) The preposition attaches the signs to the act of sending as medium or accompaniment rather than as a bare direct object. Its phrase will recur in the final clause, keeping the sign-medium constant across the ayah.

topics.headline: signs attached as medium or accompaniment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that signs are the medium accompanying dispatch, not a bare object grabbed by the verb.
topics.reason: Local attachment places the preposition over the sign noun as governed phrase with instrumental or accompaniment force.

topics.headline: first sign phrase prepares the final reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the same sign-medium phrase across the opening and closing clauses.
topics.reason: Rows note the verbatim recurrence of the prepositional sign phrase in the final policy clause.

words.gloss_range: definite plural sign category: known signs, proofs, miracles, or verses, concretized later by the she-camel example
words.root_gloss_range: root range for sign, mark, proof, verse, and contested return/refuge pressure; locally the definite plural is the sign-category under discussion
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ayat}}) The noun names a known plural category of signs rather than an indefinite marvel. Its range includes proof, miracle, and verse language, with root-dispute pressure making the signs possible points of return; the later animal example makes that abstract category visible and vulnerable. Same-surah visibility rows tie the sign field to divine showing and daylight imagery (17:1; 17:12; 17:101). The repeated sign phrase frames the ayah from the prior decree horizon (17:58) into the final policy, and the hamza's small catch makes the sign refrain audible.

topics.headline: definite plural signs are a known category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognizable sign category, broad enough for proofs, miracles, and verses, rather than one indefinite marvel.
topics.reason: Morphology rows identify the definite plural and local QAC aligns it as the governed sign noun.

topics.headline: sign range includes proof, verse, and return pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the word's sign/proof/miracle/verse range, with contested return-point pressure, while the local phrase remains the sign category under restraint.
topics.reason: Lexical rows preserve polysemy and root dispute without displacing the local sign sense.

topics.headline: signs join a same-surah visibility network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local signs within a surah pattern of showing and making visible (17:1; 17:12; 17:101).
topics.reason: Intertext rows give concrete same-surah references linking signs with visibility language.

topics.headline: sign phrase frames the ayah and the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices signs as the repeated anchor connecting the prior decree, the central example, and the final policy.
topics.reason: Echo and boundary rows connect the first sign phrase with the final recurrence and 17:58.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that makes prior denial the exclusive stated cause of restraint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illa}}) The exception particle closes the first restriction and lets only prior denial occupy the cause slot. Its later counterpart will mark purpose, so the pair gives the ayah a cause-and-purpose architecture.

topics.headline: exception isolates denial as the cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prior denial as the only stated explanation for withholding signs.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the opening restriction and introduces the denial clause.

words.gloss_range: particle introducing the denial clause as the causal content of the exception
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) This particle lets the past denial become the grammatical content of the exception: either denial itself occupies the slot, or the fact of denial is stated there. The ambiguity remains inside the same exclusive cause frame.

topics.headline: denial becomes the content of the exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices history being turned into the grammatical cause of present restraint.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the denial clause within the exception slot.

words.gloss_range: Form II denial: declaring signs false through a prepositional object construction
words.root_gloss_range: root range of falsehood, lying, fabrication, and declaring false; here Form II selects active denial of truth-claims
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبَ}} ({{tr:kadhdhaba}}) The verb does not describe mere lying; Form II makes the former peoples declare authentic signs false. Its governed prepositional object gives the denial an epistemic target, and the phrase later echoes the wronging phrase, tying rejection of evidence to moral violation. That denial field is also the hinge by which the general former-peoples clause becomes concrete in the Thamud exemplum.

topics.headline: derived verb means declaring truth false
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the former peoples actively declaring signs false, not merely making a mistaken statement.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form II and lexical rows distinguish declaring false from simple lying.

topics.headline: denial targets signs through a marked object relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejection is made with respect to the signs through the governed pronoun phrase.
topics.reason: Valency and grammar rows identify the prepositional object construction after the denial verb.

topics.headline: epistemic denial becomes moral violation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the denial phrase into the later wronging phrase, where rejection of evidence becomes enacted injustice.
topics.reason: Echo and cooccurrence rows tie the denial verb to signs and to the later wronging phrase.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun referring back to the signs as a unified denied sign-system
words.prose: {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:biha}}) The compact pronoun phrase gathers the plural signs into a feminine collective and marks them as the domain of denial. Its recurrence after the wronging verb links abstract rejection with concrete violation.

topics.headline: plural signs compressed into one pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many signs are treated as one unified sign-system being denied.
topics.reason: QAC and grammar rows identify the feminine singular pronoun as referring back to the plural sign noun as a collective.

topics.headline: preposition marks the domain of denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial aimed with respect to the signs, preserving the mediated rejection construction.
topics.reason: The phrase is the governed object construction of the denial verb.

words.gloss_range: definite plural subject naming the earlier peoples as precedent-setting deniers
words.root_gloss_range: root range of firstness, priority, precedence, and returning to an origin; locally it names former peoples as the historical subject of denial
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ}} ({{tr:al-awwaluna}}) The word prevents denial from remaining abstract: the earlier peoples are the subject of the verb and become a precedent class. The following named example narrows that class into a concrete exhibit, with the long plural ending giving pause-weight before the turn. Rows about dismissal formulas show an inversion in which opponents call revelation legends of ancients (8:31; 16:24; 23:83).

topics.headline: former peoples are the subject of denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees agency assigned to an earlier human class rather than leaving denial abstract.
topics.reason: Grammar rows make the plural noun the nominative subject of the denial verb.

topics.headline: priority becomes precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being earlier matters because their response sets the pattern behind the present rule.
topics.reason: Semantic rows treat formerness as precedent, not bare chronology.

topics.headline: dismissal formula is inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees an ironic reversal: elsewhere opponents dismiss revelation as legends of ancients, while here the former peoples themselves prove the divine argument (8:31; 16:24; 23:83).
topics.reason: Intertext rows cite formulas where the same former-peoples field appears in opponents' dismissal language.

topics.headline: general predecessors narrow to the named example
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the movement from a class of former deniers to a specific named case.
topics.reason: Echo rows connect the broad subject to the next named recipient.

words.gloss_range: conjunction pivoting from general prior denial to a concrete exemplum
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) This connector turns the argument from a general cause into a named case. It is a structural hinge: the following gift clause proves what the preceding former-peoples clause asserted, with a same-surah gift-sign echo at 17:101.

topics.headline: pivot from general cause to concrete exhibit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument leave the general former-peoples claim and enter a named proof case.
topics.reason: The conjunction begins the gift clause after the general denial clause.

topics.headline: same-surah gift-sign formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the gift of the she-camel as part of a broader divine sign-giving pattern in the surah (17:101).
topics.reason: The intertext rows compare this clause with the sign-giving formula at 17:101.

words.gloss_range: Form IV giving verb assigning recipient and gifted sign roles
words.root_gloss_range: root range of coming, arriving, bringing, and giving; here Form IV selects caused arrival as divine bestowal
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَيْنَا}} ({{tr:atayna}}) The verb sets up a double-object transfer: a named recipient receives a concrete sign. The form makes the she-camel a directed arrival from God, and same-surah gift rows place this act among divine grants of scripture and signs (17:2; 17:55; 17:101).

topics.headline: giving assigns recipient and gift roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the she-camel as a bestowed sign delivered to recipients, not a neutral animal incident.
topics.reason: Attachment and grammar rows identify the verb's double-object frame.

topics.headline: Form IV makes bestowal a directed arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine giving as caused arrival of evidence to a named people.
topics.reason: Form and root rows connect coming/arrival with causative giving.

words.gloss_range: proper-name recipient of the she-camel sign, fixed as a historical precedent
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field associated with the people of Thamud; possible drying-water etymology remains secondary pressure, not the local sense
words.prose: {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:thamuda}}) The proper noun marks the people as recipients before they become wrongdoers. Its fixed distribution evokes the sign-denial cycle around the she-camel (7:73; 11:64), while the possible arid-name pressure is only a cautious irony beside a living resource-sign.

topics.headline: named people receive the sign first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the people grammatically appear as beneficiaries before the ayah reports their wronging.
topics.reason: The noun is the first object of the giving verb in the local grammar.

topics.headline: fixed proper name anchors the precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a concrete historical people, not a generic group label.
topics.reason: The diptote proper-noun shape and recurrence rows fix the historical referent.

topics.headline: possible drying-water pressure remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense irony around a water-scarcity name in a she-camel cycle, while the local word remains a proper name.
topics.reason: Etymology rows are cautious and cannot replace the proper-name function.

topics.headline: name activates the she-camel sign cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the named people as a paradigmatic sign-denial case tied to the she-camel (7:73; 11:64).
topics.reason: Intertext rows cite the she-camel sign cycle with concrete references.

words.gloss_range: definite she-camel as the concrete, living object given as a sign
words.root_gloss_range: root range centered on the she-camel; locally a rare concrete animal noun bears the sign function in the Thamud cycle
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاقَةَ}} ({{tr:al-naqata}}) The noun turns the ayah's abstract sign-policy into a particular living creature. Its rarity and Thamud restriction make it load-bearing, and the following sight-giving participle binds the animal to signhood rather than ordinary livestock.

topics.headline: the she-camel is the delivered sign-bearing object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the animal itself as the object bestowed and immediately qualified as sign-bearing.
topics.reason: Grammar rows make the noun the second object of the giving verb and anchor the following participle.

topics.headline: abstract sign becomes a living creature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ethical sharpness of rejecting a vulnerable animal rather than an abstract proof.
topics.reason: Semantic rows stress the concrete animal and its vulnerable sign function.

topics.headline: rare noun invokes the constrained sign cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the noun as rare and tied to the she-camel tradition rather than ordinary livestock.
topics.reason: Distribution rows tie the noun to the constrained Thamud sign-cycle and possession formulas (7:73; 11:64; 91:13).

words.gloss_range: feminine active participle describing the she-camel as sight-giving or insight-making
words.root_gloss_range: root range of seeing, sight, perception, insight, and making visible; here Form IV active participle gives the sign perceptual agency
words.prose: {{ar:مُبْصِرَةًۭ}} ({{tr:mubsiratan}}) The participle is not merely visible; the active form makes the she-camel a sign that produces sight or insight. Case and variant rows show the pressure between bound state, predicate-like assertion, and passive sight, while the main reading keeps vision-giving agency attached to the animal. Its same-surah counterpart with the day-sign (17:12) and its contrast with the following wronging verb make perception the hinge of the exemplum.

topics.headline: case and variant readings expose the participle's role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the main accusative as a bound state or qualifier while variant readings show how easily the description could stand more independently or passively.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the accusative local form while variant rows preserve contrastive parses.

topics.headline: active participle gives perceptual agency to the sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the she-camel as a sign that makes sight or insight possible, not just an object visible to the eye.
topics.reason: Form rows identify the Form IV active participle and distinguish it from passive sight variants.

topics.headline: same word links she-camel and day-sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the she-camel's sign function to the daylight sign elsewhere in the surah (17:12).
topics.reason: Intertext rows cite the same word in 17:12.

topics.headline: sight-giving meets dark wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the following wronging as a reversal of the sign's purpose: illumination is answered by dark injustice.
topics.reason: Echo rows connect this participle directly with the following wronging root.

words.gloss_range: sequential particle making the wronging follow the gift as an abrupt consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) The short connector makes the move from divine gift to human wronging immediate and sharp. It turns the contrast between generosity and crime into a grammatical sequence, not just a thematic contrast.

topics.headline: gift turns immediately into wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels no neutral gap between receiving the sign and violating it.
topics.reason: The particle marks immediate sequence or causal occasion before the wronging verb.

topics.headline: short connector snaps into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quick turn from the long sign description to the judgment verb.
topics.reason: The sound row treats the brief particle as an abrupt recitational pivot.

words.gloss_range: completed collective wronging with an open object relation to the she-camel/sign
words.root_gloss_range: root range of wronging, injustice, misplacement, and darkness; here it selects completed moral wrong while darkness pressure contrasts with the sight-giving sign
words.prose: {{ar:ظَلَمُوا۟}} ({{tr:zalamu}}) The verb presents the people's response as a completed collective act and leaves the direct object open while the following pronoun phrase supplies the relation. After the sight-giving participle, the root's darkness pressure makes the wronging a perceptual reversal: a sign meant to illuminate is met with dark injustice. The row echo to self-wronging at 2:57 keeps the act self-destructive as well as sign-directed.

topics.headline: wronging remains open while relation is specified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wronging is broad enough to include the sign-context and themselves, while the next phrase gives its relation.
topics.reason: Grammar rows note the omitted direct object and following prepositional relation.

topics.headline: completed plural act becomes precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response as a finished collective precedent, not a vague tendency.
topics.reason: QAC and form rows identify the perfect plural Form I verb.

topics.headline: darkness field answers the sight-giving sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the moral and perceptual reversal: the clear sign is met with dark injustice.
topics.reason: Lexical and echo rows connect the darkness/wronging field with the preceding sight-giving participle.

topics.headline: sign rejection becomes ethical failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees epistemic denial converted into moral wrongdoing against signs, with self-destructive resonance (2:57).
topics.reason: Collocation and intertext rows connect wronging with sign-denial fields and self-wronging language.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun holding the she-camel and the sign-status together as the sphere of wronging
words.prose: {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:biha}}) This pronoun phrase can mean through her, because of her, or concerning her, so the animal and the sign she embodies stay layered. Its echo of the earlier denial phrase makes wronging the animal a concrete form of wronging the sign, bridging general denial and physical violation through the same compact relation.

topics.headline: preposition keeps instrument, cause, and concern live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wronging is through, because of, or concerning the she-camel/sign, not reduced to one narrow object relation.
topics.reason: Rows preserve the valid prepositional range after the wronging verb.

topics.headline: pronoun holds animal and sign together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wronging the animal as wronging the divine sign she embodies.
topics.reason: Referent evidence ties the pronoun to the she-camel while CRITICAL rows preserve the embodied sign layer.

topics.headline: repeated pronoun phrase bridges denial and violence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the phrase from denied signs to the wronged embodied sign, making the general denial concrete.
topics.reason: Echo rows identify the repeated pronoun phrase across the two accusations.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction lifting the exemplum into the final present-tense policy clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) The connector moves out of the named example and into a universal rule. It also completes the three-conjunction architecture and reprises the opening launch of the ayah.

topics.headline: resumption from exemplum to policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the named case being lifted into the final present-tense rule.
topics.reason: The conjunction begins the final universal policy clause after the exemplum.

topics.headline: third conjunction closes the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening launch return as the ayah completes its three-part architecture.
topics.reason: Rows identify the third conjunction and opening phrase reprise as structural closure.

words.gloss_range: second negator in a present-tense restriction defining the purpose of sign-sending
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) This negator now scopes over an ongoing sending verb, not the earlier past restraint. It opens the final restriction in which warning becomes the only stated purpose of signs, and the returning wa-ma launch with nasal onset makes the final rule sound like the answer to the opening problem.

topics.headline: negation scopes over ongoing sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause state a standing policy, not another past explanation.
topics.reason: The negator governs the indicative present verb in the final restriction clause.

topics.headline: restriction defines signs as warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices alternative purposes excluded so warning becomes the stated function of sign-sending.
topics.reason: The negation is completed by the final exception and purpose word.

topics.headline: opening sound pattern returns near closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final rule answer the opening problem through a repeated launch pattern.
topics.reason: Sound and structure rows connect the final phrase with the ayah opening.

words.gloss_range: indicative Form IV sending verb stating ongoing policy rather than suspended dispatch
words.root_gloss_range: root range of sending, releasing, dispatching, and commissioning; here Form IV selects deliberate divine dispatch under a purpose restriction
words.prose: {{ar:نُرْسِلُ}} ({{tr:nursilu}}) The same sending root returns, but now in indicative mood as a standing policy. The recurrence answers the earlier suspended verb: signs are not withheld because God cannot send them, but when they are sent their release is governed by warning. Formula rows connect this purpose-limit with other sending restriction statements (6:48; 18:56).

topics.headline: indicative verb states ongoing policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final sending verb as present divine practice, not a suspended prevented action.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as indicative while CRITICAL rows contrast it with the earlier subjunctive.

topics.headline: release is governed by warning purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine dispatch is controlled and purposeful, not spectacle.
topics.reason: Root and clause rows connect sending with the final warning restriction.

topics.headline: sending formula defines purpose by exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurring restriction pattern for divine sending (6:48; 18:56).
topics.reason: Intertext rows cite comparable purpose-limit formulas.

words.gloss_range: second preposition keeping signs as the constant medium of the final warning clause
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) The repeated preposition attaches the signs to the present-tense sending verb just as before. The medium has not changed; what changes is the clause's focus from withheld signs to signs sent as warning communication. Its short clitic attachment makes the dependency audible as well as syntactic.

topics.headline: same sign-medium attachment in the final clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the medium remains signs even though tense and purpose have shifted.
topics.reason: The second preposition governs the same definite sign noun under the present sending verb.

topics.headline: warning remains sign-mediated communication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final policy as communication through signs, not punishment detached from signs.
topics.reason: Semantic rows connect the prepositional sign phrase with the warning purpose.

words.gloss_range: repeated definite plural signs now functioning inside the final warning policy
words.root_gloss_range: root range for sign, mark, proof, verse, and contested return/refuge pressure; locally the repeated definite plural becomes the sign-category sent for warning
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ayat}}) The second occurrence keeps the same definite sign category but places it between present sending and final warning. Its recurrence bookends the argument around the named example: signs were withheld because denied, embodied in the central case, and sent only as warning. The prior decree-to-sign handoff remains visible from 17:58, and the repeated hamza catch makes the sign refrain audible at closure.

topics.headline: same definite plural category returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the sign category remains constant while the clause role changes.
topics.reason: The second occurrence repeats the same definite plural form as the first.

topics.headline: broad sign range is narrowed to warning function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the sign/proof/miracle/verse range while seeing the final clause select warning as its function.
topics.reason: Lexical rows preserve broad sign range, but the final purpose word narrows local function.

topics.headline: repeated signs frame the central exemplum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's ring: signs withheld because denied, embodied in the center, and sent only as warning.
topics.reason: Echo and structure rows identify the sign phrase as the bookend around the central example.

words.gloss_range: final exception particle making warning the exclusive stated purpose of sign-sending
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}) This exception particle changes the slot from cause to purpose. Together with the first exception, it closes the ayah's logic: denial explains restraint, and warning explains sending. The repeated heavy exception sound concentrates the closure pressure at the final restriction.

topics.headline: exception makes warning the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning move from possible effect to the sole stated purpose of sign-sending.
topics.reason: The final exception completes the present-tense restriction and introduces the purpose word.

topics.headline: second exception completes the cause-purpose pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's two-part logic: denial explains stopping, warning explains sending.
topics.reason: Rows explicitly pair the two exception particles and distinguish their functions.

words.gloss_range: Form II verbal noun in accusative purpose/state position: causing fear as warning or danger-awareness
words.root_gloss_range: root range of fear, apprehension, alarm, caution, and warning; here Form II verbal noun selects caused fear or protective alert as the purpose of signs
words.prose: {{ar:تَخْوِيفًۭا}} ({{tr:takhwifa}}) The final word names warning as an action or process, not a mere emotion. Its accusative role can be purpose or state, its Form II shape makes fear caused or danger made perceptible, and its final position makes warning the ayah's closing explanation for sign-sending. Nearby fear language (17:57; 17:60), the prior destruction horizon (17:58), and the echo with the sight-giving participle all make the warning communicative rather than spectacle.

topics.headline: accusative makes warning the function of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warning as the purpose or mode of sign-sending, not as incidental emotion.
topics.reason: Grammar rows identify the accusative as purpose or circumstantial state.

topics.headline: Form II names causing fear or danger-awareness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as an intentional warning process that makes danger perceptible.
topics.reason: Form and lexical rows identify the Form II verbal noun and distinguish it from simple fear.

topics.headline: warning completes the sign-sending field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word close the circuit among signs, sending, and warning.
topics.reason: Collocation rows pair the warning root with sending and sign fields.

topics.headline: final word condenses the ayah's argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end on the purpose of all sign-sending after restraint, denial, gift, and wronging.
topics.reason: Structure rows make the final position interpretively central.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions about what prevented sending and why signs are sent join prevention, dispatch, prior falsification, and fear in one policy statement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus ayah opposes prevention as blockage to sending as release. Earlier falsification supplies historical feedback: manifest markers are not withheld through incapacity but dispatched selectively because a prior release was converted into denial; those still sent aim at caution rather than compelled assent.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between an agent and an intended act supplies the blockage side of the dispatch circuit.
Release and sending supply the outbound movement regulated by that barrier.
A manifest marker identifies what is released as publicly legible evidence.
Attributing something or its bearer to falsehood supplies the recipient action that feeds back into restraint.
Temporal precedence locates the decisive reception failure in earlier communities.
Putting fear into another supplies the stated purpose of provoking precaution.

changed_reading.before: Fewer spectacular signs could look like arbitrary refusal or inability to provide evidence.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a historically calibrated dispatch policy: prior falsification blocks escalation, while signs still released aim to awaken precaution rather than force assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of giving Thamud the she-camel, qualifying it as sight-giving or visibly evident, and then saying they wronged by means of it binds disclosure to their treatment of the disclosed sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Giving makes the camel a furnished relation, not merely an object on display. Its visibility opens bodily and inward perception, but wrongdoing puts that relation out of place; the sign therefore diagnoses how recipients handle a right-bearing disclosure as much as it proves a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Giving and delivery make the camel an entrusted provision placed into a community relation.
The literal she-camel anchors the diagnostic mechanism in the ayah's concrete sign.
Ocular seeing supplies the sign's overt visibility and capacity to confront the witness.
Inward discernment keeps open the stronger possibility that the sign is meant to awaken recognition, not merely be seen.
Putting something in an improper place turns their response into a relational misuse of the disclosed sign.

changed_reading.before: The she-camel is a spectacular proof that is subsequently rejected or violated.
changed_reading.after: The she-camel is also a sight-bearing relational test: its disclosure exposes whether recipients will recognize and rightly place what has been given, or convert visibility into an occasion of injustice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context expands prevention from upstream non-dispatch into a full reception circuit. Varied reminder grows aversion; pervasive praise remains uncomprehended; barriers and ear-weight make present speech functionally inaccessible; and sign-like analogies become loss of path. Presence and visibility therefore do not guarantee uptake, sharpening why more spectacle can be withheld.

activation_trace.role: The focus barrier is reread as one stage in a broader circuit of blocked access.
Inward discernment anchors the contextual reception failures back in the focus sign's perceptual claim.
Turning discourse through differing forms supplies repeated presentation intended to alter reception.
Drawing away supplies the inverse result produced by that repeated presentation.
Failure of comprehension shows that an available signifying field can remain cognitively unopened.
Blocked access supplies a contextual counterpart to the focus ayah's prevention.
Weight in the ear materializes reception failure even while speech is present.
An analogy capable of serving as lesson or sign becomes the very material of misreading.
Departure from the intended path names the endpoint of the failed interpretive circuit.

structural_cues: 17:41 gives an intended reminder followed by the inverse result of greater aversion.
17:44-48 progress from uncomprehended signification to veiled and weighted reception and then misdirected analogy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variation, aversion, incomprehension, barriers, ear-weight, and errant analogies; I supply the arrow that these are stages of one reception blockade explaining the focus restraint. They may instead describe distinct audiences or independent failures.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah concerns a historical refusal to send another extraordinary sign after one earlier denial.
changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses a repeatable reception blockade: signs can be present, varied, visible, and lesson-bearing yet be converted into aversion or misdirection, so non-dispatch is not evidence scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material challenge moves from imagined maximal resistance, stone or iron, to return by the first originator and response to a summons. That sequence separates power to produce or restore from the decision to dispatch demanded signs, strengthening the focus claim that restraint is communicative judgment rather than incapacity.

activation_trace.role: The focus barrier supplies the apparent obstruction whose nature the material challenge clarifies.
Literal stone supplies an imagined state of extreme material resistance.
Iron-like hardness intensifies the imagined resistance beyond ordinary bodily decay.
Return after departure supplies restoration despite the imagined hardening or disintegration.
Origination supplies the power basis for that restoration.
Answering a call completes the movement from resistant material to responsive creature.

structural_cues: 17:49-52 move from fragmentation and self-hardening as stone or iron to renewed creation and immediate response.
The question about who restores is answered by the first originator, distinguishing ability from the policy of sending requested signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imagined material resistance, origination, return, and response; I infer that this sequence rules out power-deficit as the focus ayah's prevention and assigns the barrier to communicative history. An alternative is that the sequence addresses resurrection only and does not qualify sign-dispatch.

changed_reading.before: What prevents further signs might be read as some limit imposed by resistant people or impossible demands.
changed_reading.after: Even maximal material resistance remains under origination and recall; the withheld sign is therefore a choice about the efficacy and consequence of disclosure, not a limit on power.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hope for mercy and fear of punishment are joined to vigilant caution immediately before communal destruction is described as fixed in writing. The focus sign's fear-making function can therefore be read as creating an anticipatory interval for guarded response before consequence, not merely displaying terror.

activation_trace.role: Induced fear anchors the contextual caution mechanism in the focus ayah's explicit purpose.
A heart reaching toward what is hoped for keeps warning paired with positive expectation.
Merciful tenderness supplies the live favorable pole beside feared punishment.
Alert self-protection supplies the practical response fear is capable of producing.
Falling into destruction supplies the consequence before which warning operates.
Written establishment gives that consequence juridical and temporal firmness.

structural_cues: 17:57 coordinates hope, mercy, fear, punishment, and caution rather than isolating fear.
17:58 places fixed communal consequence immediately before 17:59 defines the function of signs as fear-making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope, mercy, vigilant caution, fixed destruction, and then fear-signs; I supply the temporal arrow that warning opens a protective response interval before consequence. The live alternative is a narrower announcement-of-punishment function without a protective implication.

changed_reading.before: Sending signs for fear can sound like terror as an end in itself.
changed_reading.after: Fear-signs can function as anticipatory mercy: they make danger actionable as vigilance before a written consequence, while not guaranteeing escape or assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel couples a shown vision with assay and repeated fear-making with growth in transgression. This makes warning non-coercive and bifurcating: the same disclosure may awaken caution or expose and amplify boundary-crossing. The earlier denial in the focus ayah becomes evidence about sign dynamics, not an incidental historical note.

activation_trace.role: Overt visibility anchors the focus camel to the sequel's deliberately shown object.
Attribution to falsehood supplies the earlier adverse branch of sign reception.
Relational misplacement supplies the focus form of the wrongdoing that disclosure exposes.
Deliberate showing supplies a close contextual analogue to the focus sign's made-visible quality.
Assaying a person as metal supplies the diagnostic rather than coercive function of disclosure.
Repeated fear-making directly carries the focus purpose into the sequel.
Growth supplies the inverse effect by which warning intensifies rather than reduces the response.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion names what the warning unexpectedly increases.
The alternate mapped inventory independently preserves excess beyond the limit as the intensified outcome.

structural_cues: 17:60 immediately repeats causative fear after 17:59 and states an inverse increase rather than correction.
The shown vision, assay, and growing transgression reproduce the focus sequence of visible sign, wrongdoing, and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible disclosure, assay, fear-making, increase, and transgression; I infer a bifurcating sign mechanism in which disclosure reveals and may amplify an existing posture, thereby rationalizing restraint. The alternative is that only the particular vision and tree are tests while other signs remain straightforwardly corrective.

changed_reading.before: A warning sign is expected to reduce wrongdoing if it is sufficiently vivid.
changed_reading.after: A warning sign is a non-coercive assay whose visibility may produce caution or intensify transgression; withholding stronger spectacle can therefore limit the consequences of a repeatedly adverse reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant milk branches of sending and falsifying; it remains anchored by those exact focus roots and the literal she-camel between them. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for provision and cessation, not as the lexical denotation of the verbs or a historical claim about the camel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah places two occurrences of sending, falsification, giving, and the she-camel inside one account of why sign-dispatch is restrained.

activation_trace.role: Continuing milk-flow recasts repeated sending as a released yield or provision.
Milk that was expected to continue but fails supplies a material image for denial interrupting a presumed flow.
The literal she-camel keeps the milk-flow analogy visibly attached to the focus ayah.

changed_reading.before: Signs are abstract proofs, and the she-camel is only one disconnected example of a rejected miracle.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sign-dispatch resembles a continuing provision whose material carrier is the she-camel; denial is imagined as a flow that fails, so withholding becomes cessation of a squandered yield.

strongest_changes: Non-dispatch became a calibrated response to a reception circuit, not evidence scarcity or incapacity.
The visible camel became an assay of relational justice: disclosure can expose wrong rather than settle belief.
The immediate 17:60 echo made fear-signs bifurcating tests that may intensify transgression, explaining restraint.
Fear became an interval for vigilant response before an inscribed end, not only a threat.
summary.what_was_special: The closest context twice inverts the expected effect of disclosure: varied reminder grows aversion in 17:41, and fear-making grows transgression in 17:60. That makes the focus ayah's historical restriction causal rather than incidental.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the camel's visual qualifier primarily means visibly evident, sight-giving, or perception-awakening remains open.
The protective reading of fear-making depends on linking 17:57 caution and 17:58 decree to 17:59; the narrower punitive reading remains live.
The milk-flow outlier is a branch-level material analogy, not a claim about lexical denotation or event history.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A visible sign is withheld when precedent shows visibility does not force right placement.** `م ن ع:B002` blocks access, `ء ي ي:B003` is visible sign, `ب ص ر:B001/B002` sight and insight, `ظ ل م:B004` puts something in the wrong place, and `خ و ف:B002` causes caution. The she-camel was sight-giving yet mishandled; therefore signs are sent as warning, not compulsion. I infer more visibility cannot repair a will that misplaces what it sees. The limitation reads as historically informed mercy against repeated sign-destruction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:101's nine clear signs sharpened the withholding: a later sign-total is explicitly recalled only to show accusation persisting, confirming that quantity does not cure misplacement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A visible sign is warning infrastructure, not coercive spectacle.** Lexical evidence: `م ن ع B002` (a barrier between a person and what he seeks) in `مَنَعَنَآ`, `ب ص ر B001` (seeing with the eye) in `مُبْصِرَةً`, and `خ و ف B002` (making another afraid) in `تَخْوِيفًا`. Structural cue: earlier peoples' denial stands between the desire for signs and their dispatch; the she-camel was made perceptible yet met with wrong, while 17:60 immediately names vision and tree as trials. Assigned role: historical rejection supplies the barrier, visibility establishes perceptual availability, and fear redirects the sign toward caution. Abductive move: the packet gives one visible sign that failed to compel right response; I infer that more spectacle would not repair the receiving mechanism. Reading change: signs are sent to warn and test response, not to eliminate the freedom or interpretive conditions under which denial occurs.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:60 explicitly called vision and tree a trial, confirming that the warning function of signs is to expose response rather than force a predetermined act of assent.

baseline.text: Bizi ayetleri göndermekten alıkoyan tek şey, öncekilerin onları yalanlamasıdır. Semud'a gözle görülür bir ayet olarak dişi deveyi verdik, fakat onun karşısında haksızlık ettiler. Biz ayetleri yalnızca korkutmak için göndeririz.

findings.text: Gözle görülür işaretin geçmişte kabulü zorlamaması, işaretlerin özgür tepkiyi ortadan kaldıran gösteriler değil, yönü uyaran ve alıcının tavrını sınayan araçlar olduğunu gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A sign does not compel a neutral observer; it enters a preexisting disposition and makes acceptance, denial, fear, or overflow visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Warning is less a coercive spectacle than an assay: inscription fixes the outcome, visible evidence tests the receiver, and the receiver's reaction can amplify the very excess being warned against.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inscribed End and the Rejected Visible Sign
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A settlement's end is already written; earlier denial blocks repetition of signs, while a conspicuous living sign is wronged and becomes warning rather than compulsion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathered settlement (`quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`); extinction (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); preceding time (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); written line (`quranic:root_000704:B001/m01`); barrier against access (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`); dispatch of a sign (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); manifest token (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); denial of truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); she-camel (`quranic:root_001567:B002/m01`); visual disclosure (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); induced warning-fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Inscription fixes the town's temporal horizon, while the history of denial governs whether another sign will be sent. The she-camel is a visible, embodied token, yet visibility does not force fidelity. The sign instead discloses how its recipients handle entrusted evidence.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, dalı vermenin karşıtı olan esirgeme ve özellikle iyiliği vermeyen kişinin cimrice tutumu olarak açıkça kurar. Bu çerçeve, birini istediği şeyden alıkoyma ya da koruyucu güç yoluyla erişimi önleme anlamlarından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın odağı, bir yararı ya da verilebilecek şeyi başkasına vermemektir; genel engelleme ve koruma bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, vermemenin genel çekirdeği ile kişiyi sürekli esirgeyen ya da cimri gösteren türemiş kullanımları ayırarak kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Verilebilecek bir şeyi ya da iyiliği başkasına vermemek, elde tutmak veya esirgemektir. Kişiye uygulandığında bu tutum, iyiliği sürekli engelleyen cimrice bir özellik olarak belirginleşir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi vermenin karşıtı olarak onu elde tutma ve başkasına vermeme eylemidir.
İyiliği sürekli vermeyen kişi bakımından cimrilik ve esirgeyicilik özelliğine dönüşür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir kişiye engel olmasını buyuran kalıplaşmış tek sözcüklü bir buyruk kullanımını açıkça tanımlar. Bu kimlik, aynı ses yapısındaki cimri kişi nitelemesinden bütünüyle ayrıdır ve yalnızca bu özel buyruk işlevinde geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca muhataba engel olmasını söyleyen kalıplaşmış buyruk sözüdür; kişi niteliği veya genel engelleme adı değildir.

Ancak toplu tanıklık, bu dayanmanın nedenini bir yerde açıkça gençliğe bağlarken başka bir yerde farklı bir neden sözü verir; bu yüzden gençlik açıklaması ortak çekirdeğin zorunlu parçası değil, kaynak değişkeni olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca adı verilen iki genç dişi hayvanın yıl veya zaman karşısındaki dayanma tasviridir; genel gençlik ya da her türlü direnme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, adı verilen hayvan ikilisine özgü kalıplaşmış kullanımı korur; bunu yalın kökün genel direnme veya gençlik anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Genç dişi deve ile dişi oğlağı, çetin yılın veya zamanın etkisine karşı kendilerini savunan iki genç hayvan olarak birlikte adlandıran özel bir kullanımdır. Gençlikleri bu dayanmanın bir açıklaması olarak verilir, ancak neden anlatımı kaynaklar arasında tam olarak birleşmez.

facets.statement: Özel adlandırma, genç dişi deve ile dişi oğlağı tek bir hayvan ikilisi olarak gösterir.
İki hayvan, çetin yıla veya zamana karşı kendilerini savunan varlıklar gibi benzetmeli biçimde tasvir edilir.
Dayanmanın gençlikten geldiği açıklaması tanıklıklardan birinde açıkken toplu neden anlatımı tam bir birlik göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi gönderme veya serbest bırakma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, elçi, rüzgar veya yağmur bir hedefe yöneltildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı harekete geçirip bir yöne yollamayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tutulan bir canlı veya denetlenen bir güç üzerindeki engel kaldırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tutmayı bırakıp serbest hareket imkanı verme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, doğal güçlerin yöneltilmesini ve tutulan bir şeyin salıverilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir kişi, hayvan veya topluluğun belirli bir ihtiyaç ya da hedef için görevlendirilerek yollanmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın bir hedefe doğru hareket ettirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın serbest bırakma ve doğal güçleri gönderme alanı daha geniştir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise amaçlı görevlendirmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haber veya görev için yollamayı da açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, engeli kaldırma, yol açma ve çözme gibi daha genel kolaylaştırma biçimlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir varlığın tutulmadan hareket etmesine imkan verebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta gönderme işlemi kurucudur; komşuda asıl vurgu hareketi engelleyen bağı kaldırmaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gönderme veya salıverme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gönderilen haber taşıyıcısını ya da taşınan haberin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı gönderici, taşıma ve hedef senaryosunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Eylem ile o eylemin taşıyıcısı veya içeriği birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz dış aday ile on kardeş dalın tümü değerlendirildi; yalnızca gönderme, serbest bırakma ve gönderilen öğe sınırlarını doğrudan açıklayan üç karşıtlık seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إرسال الإنسان وغيره وبعث الرسل والرياح والمطر والتخلية والإطلاق في مقابل الإمساك

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على الانبعاث والامتداد (maqayis)؛ أرسلت فلانا في رسالة والمرسلات الرياح ويقال الملائكة (sihah)؛ إرسال الله أنبياءه وإرسال الشياطين تخليتهم وإياهم (tahdhib)؛ الإرسال يقابل الإمساك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
İçerik okumasında sözcük, taşıyıcının götürdüğü sözün veya haberin kendisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, gönderici ile alıcı arasındaki aktarımı hem taşıyıcı kişi hem de taşınan söz bakımından kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi ile içerik arasında kurduğu iki yönlü adlandırmayı en kısa biçimde birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gönderen adına hareket eden kişiyi hem de onun taşıdığı iletiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz veya haber taşıyan kişinin kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gönderen adına haber taşıyan kişi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisini adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisi kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndericiden alıcıya taşınan içerik yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İçeriği taşıyan kişiyi adlandırmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir haberin göndericiden alıcıya ulaşması senaryosundadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta taşıyıcı veya içerik, komşuda ise başarıyla ulaştırma eylemi kurucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, taşınan sözün kendisini de adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın kişi anlamı vekillik ve güvence üstlenme rollerine de uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da başkası adına iş gören veya haber taşıyan bir kişi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak haber taşıma ve ileti içeriğine bağlıdır; komşu temsil ve güvence rollerini de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal taşıyıcı kişiyi veya taşınan haberi adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yürüyüş, uzuv ve saç gerçekleşmelerini tek bir fiziksel nitelik altında kapsayan kavramsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın veya topluluğun zorlanmadan ilerlemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dirençsiz ve kolay hareket niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Saçın veya uzuvların yumuşak ve salık oluşunu kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan aşağı doğru uzanması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak ve serbest uzanma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kolay yürüyüş ve yumuşak eklem yönlerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zorlamasız ve yumuşak ilerleyişi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnız yürüyüş eylemine bağlıdır; odak dal aynı niteliği beden yapısına ve saça da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak fiziksel hareket ve biçimle sınırlıyken komşu daha genel nitelik ve davranış alanını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bedeni zorlamayan rahat ilerleyişi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sırtı yoran ve güçsüzü kapasitesinin üstünde zorlayan sert ilerleyişi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yürüyüşü harcanan güç ve bedensel yük bakımından değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı çaba ekseninde odak düşük direnç ve rahatlığı, komşu yüksek yük ve zorlamayı kodlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, konuşmayı veya okumayı aceleye getirmeden; sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık, dikkat ve denetimle yürütmektir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, aceleyi bırakıp ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemektir.
İş ve konuşmada sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık ve karar vermeden önce sağlamlaştırma öne çıkar.
Okumada metni acele etmeden açık, belirgin ve dikkatli söyleme kastedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, acele etmeme buyruğunu ve iş, konuşma, okuma alanlarındaki sakin, dikkatli ilerleyişi ortak bir ölçülülük çekirdeğinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İş, konuşma ve okuma alanlarında ortak olan sakinlik ve denetim niteliğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme, sakinlik, dikkat ve kontrollü ilerleme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye yavaşlaması ve işi ölçülü yürütmesi söylendiğinde doğal buyruktur.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme ve sakin davranma isteğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Okumadaki açık söyleyiş ve işteki sağlamlaştırma ayrıntılarını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Metnin acele edilmeden açık ve belirgin biçimde okunması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Okumada yavaşlık, açıklık ve denetimi korur.
error_profile.loses: İş ve genel konuşmadaki ağırbaşlı tutumu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan veya hayvanların tek bir kütle halinde değil, biri ötekinin ardından gelen ayrı kümeler halinde gelişini ve bu kümelerin her birini anlatır. Çerçeve, topluluk ile ardışıklık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, peş peşe gelen ayrı toplulukları ve sürüleri kapsar; haber taşıyıcısını veya sütün kendisini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ardışık topluluk çekirdeğini korur; tek sürü adı ile grup grup gelme anlatımı kendi sözcük biçimlerinde ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların, develerin, koyunların veya başka varlıkların ayrı topluluklar halinde, bir küme ötekinin ardından gelecek biçimde ilerlemesi ya da bu kümelerin her biridir.

İnsan ve at topluluklarında da grup grup, biri diğerinin ardından gelme anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sütü, özellikle bol ve sürekli gelen sütü kapsar; sürü, ileti veya genel bolluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu birimi onceki anlamin aciklamasini baslatan ve ardindan gelen sozle neyin kastedildigini gosteren unsur olarak verir. Dal cercevesi soru veya nida isleviyle karistirmadan dogru ayrim yapar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Non-bare kapsam, tanimi yalniz aciklama baslatan gramer birimiyle sinirlar; genel isaret veya soru anlami yuklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Onceki sozun veya anlamin ne demek oldugunu gostermek icin aciklama ifadesinden once gelen yorumlayici gramer birimi.

Ardindan gelen ifade, anlatilmak istenen anlamin aciklayici karsiligidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu birimi yemin veya ant oncesinde gelen, evet ya da bilakis onay degeri tasiyan acilis sozu olarak verir. Dal cercevesi bunu soru, aciklama ve zamir islevlerinden ayirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Non-bare kapsam, tanimi yalniz yeminle birlikte kullanilan onaylayici gramer sozune baglar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yemin ifadesinden once gelip sozu onaylayan veya pekistiren, evet ya da bilakis degeri tasiyan acilis birimi.

facets.statement: Yemin ifadesini baslatir ve ona onaylayici bir giris saglar.
Anlam degeri evet ya da bilakis gibi tasdik edici cevap sozune yakindir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu birimi yemin oncesinde gelen acilis veya baglayici soz olarak verir; anlam degeri tasdik ve pekistirme yonundedir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi birbirinden ayrik gramer birimleriyle bekleme, kisiyi hedefleme, gorunen belirti, soru-belirleme, zamir dayanagi, zaman ve nicelik sorusu, nida, aciklama ve yemin oncesi tasdik alanlarini tasir. Dallar arasindaki bag cogu yerde bicimsel yakinliktir; anlam duzeni tek bir cekirdege indirgenemeyecek kadar cok kolludur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı doğruluğun karşıtı olarak kurar ve bu karşıtlığın hem sözde hem davranışta gerçekleşebildiğini açıkça belirtir. Kişiyi bu nitelikle betimleyen biçimler aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır; birini yalancı sayma eylemi ise ayrı dalın konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçeğe aykırı söz ve davranışı kapsar; başkasını yalancılıkla niteleme eylemini ya da özel kalıpların bağımsız anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi betimleyen türevler ile özürlere ilişkin kalıp yalnız kendi sözcüksel karşılıklarında gösterilir ve yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün veya davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasıdır. Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, yalan söyleyen ya da yalanı çokça tekrarlayan biri olarak betimlenebilir.

facets.statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
Bu niteliği taşıyan veya onu sıkça gösteren kişi, yalan söyleyen kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğa aykırılığı ortak çekirdek sayar; kullanım alanını söz ve davranış olarak verir ve bu niteliği taşıyan kişiye yönelik adlandırmaları aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem söz hem davranış alanındaki bütün yalın anlam çekirdeğini karşılayan açıklayıcı üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğa karşıtlığı ve bunun söz ile davranıştaki kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın söz veya davranıştaki doğruluğa aykırılığı zaten belirginleştirdiği doğal kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğa aykırılık çekirdeğini ve kişiye yüklenebilen niteliği doğal Türkçeyle korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğruluğa aykırı sözün veya davranışın kendisini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçeğe aykırı içeriğin ya da davranışın niteliğidir; komşu dal ise bir kişi veya söz hakkında bu yönde hüküm verme işlemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel doğruluğa aykırılıktır; komşu dal bunun daha ağır, saptırılmış veya başkalarını yanlış yöne sevk eden türünü belirginleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söz dışındaki davranışlarda görülen doğruluğa aykırılığı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilgiye dayanmadan tahmin yürütme ve doğrulanmamış söz söyleme alanını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gerçek dışı veya dayanaksız söz söyleme bağlamlarında iki anlam birbirine yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal söz ve davranıştaki genel doğruluğa aykırılıktır; komşu dal özellikle bilgi yerine tahmine dayanarak asılsız söz üretmeyi de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her türlü sözsel veya davranışsal doğruluğa aykırılığı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalancı tanıklık, haktan sapma ve batıl sayılan nesneler gibi özel alanlara uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel yalan ile haktan sapmış söz
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçek ve hakikate aykırı söz alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel yalan niteliğidir; komşu dal yalanı özellikle haktan sapma, yalancı tanıklık ve batıllık çevresinde örgütler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözün ya da davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasını doğrudan bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kesinlik bulunmadan aktarılan, kuşkulu veya doğruluğu güven vermeyen sözü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kuşkulu bir iddianın gerçek dışı çıkması durumunda iki alan kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluğa aykırılığı temel alır; komşu dal ise sözün kesinlik ve güven düzeyine odaklanır, bu nedenle her kuşkulu aktarım yalan değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yalanla en kolay karışan beş anlam yayımlandı, yalnızca aynı senaryoda bulunan özel kalıplar ve uzak tematik adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكذب في القول والفعل، ووصف صاحبه بالكاذب والكذاب والكذوب، وجمع الأكاذيب والمكاذب
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه فعل التكذيب والنسبة إلى الكذب، ولا إغراء كذب عليك، ولا الألفاظ الاصطلاحية الخاصة بالحملة واللبن والثوب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكذب خلاف الصدق (maqayis;jamhara); الكذاب لغة في الكذب (ayn); كذب كذبا فهو كاذب وكذاب وكذوب (sihah); يقال في المقال والفعال (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir işlemi değil, birbirine bağlı iki işlemi içerir: bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla nitelemek ve bazı türemiş biçimlerde kişiyi yalancı bulmak ya da yalanını açığa çıkarmak. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu ayrım tek bir genel 'yalan yükleme' anlatımı içinde eritilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalan üretmeyi değil, kişi veya söz hakkında yalan hükmü vermeyi ve belirli türevlerde bu hükmü bulguya dayandırmayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, türemiş ve nesne alan biçimlerinin farklı işlemlerini ayırır; bunlardan hiçbiri yalın biçimin genel yalan anlamı olarak sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla ilişkilendirerek yalan olduğunu söylemektir. Bazı türemiş biçimlerde işlem, kişiyi yalancı bulma ya da yalanını ortaya çıkarma sonucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya söz, yalan olduğu söylenerek doğruluk bakımından olumsuz değerlendirilir.
Belirli türemiş biçimler, kişiyi yalancı bulmayı veya onun yalanını ortaya çıkarmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini ya da bir sözü yalanla niteleme konusunda birleşir; aynı toplu kanıt, ayrı bir türemiş biçimde kişiyi yalancı bulma veya yalanı açığa çıkarma yorumunu da taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hüküm verme çekirdeği ile belirli türevlerdeki bulma ve açığa çıkarma ayrımını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yalan hükmü vermeyi ve türemiş biçimde yalancı bulma işlemini ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün veya kişinin söylediğinin yalan olduğunu bildiren bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi veya söz hakkında yalan hükmü verme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişiyi yalancı bulma ve yalanını ortaya çıkarma sonucunu tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Değerlendirme sonucunda bir kişinin yalan söylediğinin anlaşıldığı türemiş biçimler için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi yalancı bulma veya yalanını açığa çıkarma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir sözü doğrudan yalan sayma ve muhataba yalan söylediğini bildirme işlemini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüklenen nitelik özellikle yalan söyleme veya sözün yalan olmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiye herhangi bir suçlama ya da kuşku iliştirmeyi, hatta onda bulunmayan olumlu bir niteliği yakıştırmayı kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişi hakkında olumsuz bir niteleme veya iddia yöneltme işlemini içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız doğruluk ve yalan eksenindeki hükme bağlıdır; komşu dalın suçlama ve kuşku alanı daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiyi yalancılıkla veya sözünü yalan olmakla niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi hırsızlık yapmakla niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişiye belirli bir olumsuz eylemi yükleyen dilsel işlemlerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İşlemin yapısı benzerdir, ancak odak dalın hükmü yalanla, komşu dalın hükmü hırsızlıkla sınırlıdır; anlam çekirdekleri birbirinin yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyi genel olarak yalancı sayabilir veya belirli bir sözü yalanlayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin yapmadığı belirli bir içme eylemini ona yükleme iddiasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiye gerçekleşmemiş bir eylem yüklenince bu iddiayı yalanlama bağlamında iki alan kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluk hakkında verilen hükümdür; komşu dal ise gerçekleşmemiş belirli bir eylemin kişiye isnat edilmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalanın kendisi, genel suçlama ve benzer isnat işlemleriyle sınırı gösteren dört aday seçildi, daha uzak söz ve özel kalıp alanları yayımlanmadı.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كذبت فلانا، وأكذبته، والتكذيب، والمكاذبة، ولا مكذبة بمعنى لا أكذبك، وقراءة لا يكذبونك في معنى لا يجدونك كاذبا أو لا ينسبونك إلى الكذب
